findings.highlight: I have no room to hesitate right now
findings.evidenceJa: 今回の申し出ばかりは躊躇せざるを得ない
findings.explanation: Whatever pressure Hamada applies, Haruki cannot help hesitating over this particular offer. The translation says he has no room to hesitate, reversing compelled hesitation into compelled action.
findings.japanese:
けど、押されようが引かれようが、
今の俺にとって今回の申し出ばかりは躊躇せざるを得ない。
findings.todokanai: But whether he plans on forcing me or luring me into this job, I have no room to hesitate right now.

findings.highlight: The first issue of this year was better than any issues we had last year
findings.evidenceJa: 今年一発目で去年のどの号よりも出た
findings.explanation: Hamada says the first issue of the year sold more copies than every issue released the previous year. The translation turns an objective circulation result into a vague claim of qualitative superiority.
findings.japanese:
「先週出た最新号のインタビュー記事が評判良くてな。
何しろ今年一発目で去年のどの号よりも出たんだよ。
…ほら、社長賞の金一封だ」
findings.todokanai: "The interview article on last week's issue received an amazing response. The first issue of this year was better than any issues we had last year… Here, it's the reward money from our president."

findings.highlight: it contains Hamada-san's own pocket change
findings.evidenceJa: 浜田さんのポケットマネーなんじゃ
findings.explanation: Haruki jokes that the suspiciously informal president's award may actually have been funded from Hamada's personal money. The translation instead says the envelope contains a trivial amount of loose change.
findings.japanese: …実は浜田さんのポケットマネーなんじゃ？
findings.todokanai: …I imagine that it contains Hamada-san's own pocket change.

findings.evidenceJa: 本人の希望じゃないのか？
findings.explanation: Hamada asks whether it might be Kazusa's own request and why Haruki believes otherwise. The translation hardens his uninformed question into near-certainty, despite the parallel scene showing Kazusa had not been consulted.
findings.japanese:
「いや、本人の希望じゃないのか？
どうして違うなんて思うんだ？」
findings.todokanai: "No, I'm pretty sure she did. Why do you think otherwise?"

findings.highlight: she said something rude during the interview
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女に何か失礼なことでもしたのか
findings.explanation: Hamada asks whether Haruki did something rude or offensive to Kazusa during the interview. The translation reverses the direction and asks whether Kazusa said something rude.
findings.japanese:
「そういえば、この前の出迎えも嫌がってたな。
ひょっとしてインタビューの時、
彼女に何か失礼なことでもしたのか？」
findings.todokanai: "By the way, you were against picking her up before too. Could it be that she said something rude during the interview?"

findings.highlight: your piano is getting more clumsy
findings.explanation: Youko says Kazusa's playing has become rough, unsettled, or emotionally wild because of her instability. The translation describes the piano itself or her technique as increasingly clumsy.
findings.japanese:
「そのせいでピアノも荒れてる。
正直、今のままの状態じゃコンサートも心許ないわね」
findings.todokanai: "Thanks to that, your piano is getting more clumsy. To be honest, I feel a bit uneasy about holding a concert at this rate."

findings.highlight: if you mess up even slightly
findings.evidenceJa: ちょっとでも腑抜けた演奏したら
findings.explanation: Youko warns that even a slightly spiritless, gutless performance will make the press turn on Kazusa after such hype. The translation changes the artistic failure into any minor technical mistake.
findings.japanese:
「前評判が高い分、ちょっとでも腑抜けた演奏したら、
あっという間に手のひらを返されるわよ？
…あなたの大嫌いなマスコミに」
findings.todokanai: "The interest in your concert is high, so if you mess up even slightly, everything will be turned on its head… by the mass media you hate so much."

findings.highlight: A lot of work in the afternoon?
findings.evidenceJa: どこ行くんだ？午後いっぱいって、何時くらいまで
findings.explanation: Kazusa asks where Youko is going and what time 'the whole afternoon' means. The destination and purpose are unstated; the translation invents that Youko has work.
findings.japanese:
「どこ行くんだ？
午後いっぱいって、何時くらいまで…」
findings.todokanai: "Where are you going? A lot of work in the afternoon? Until when…?"
